nl: Move SSH to port 2222 in etc/ssh/sshd_config.

etc/ssh/sshd_config.text:
Port 2222
PermitRootLogin yes
PasswordAuthentication yes
PubkeyAuthentication yes
X11Forwarding no
MaxAuthTries 6
Subsystem sftp /usr/lib/openssh/sftp-server

reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('etc/ssh/sshd_config'); t = p.read_text()
assert t.count('Port 22\n') == 1
p.write_text(t.replace('Port 22\n', 'Port 2222\n'))
EOF
